_note: Dev-machine config, used by system/dev-session.sh --vm via HTPC_CONFIG so it never overwrites a deployed config.json. Since the July 2026 remodel there is nothing here to launch — every screen lives in the launcher page — so this exists to point the home screen's weather somewhere and to prove the config precedence still works. To exercise the player without a real stream, tune the launcher to a channel whose URL is `av://lavfi:smptebars=size=1280x720:rate=30` in cabletv/channels.m3u.
